name: 双层沥水大容量厨房收纳架款
description: 暖木台面场景化收纳展示，一屏看全卖点、材质、容量与细节，信任背书收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating seamless warm beige gradient wall #EDE3D4, light warm grey tile/stone wall #F2F1EF and warm wood countertop #B08050, with full-bleed deep charcoal #2D2D2D info screens as rhythm breaks
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft warm studio light, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows under products, occasional raking side light to reveal texture, 4200-5000K warm-neutral
styleLock.surfaceSystem: warm wood countertop and matte light-grey stone tile, rounded white info cards floating above surfaces
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; headlines in #2D2D2D (white on dark screens), thin-line terracotta icon labels; Chinese copy wrapped in 「」
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line terracotta orange #D9622B icons with rounded rectangular info cards and pill-shaped labels
styleLock.presentationRules: stable front 3/4 hero angle on wood countertop; consistent product scale across screens; infographic screens keep product small and subordinate to layout
noDrift: no invented certification text on any screen
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm home-storage commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm beige wall #EDE3D4, light warm grey #F2F1EF, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, and one warm terracotta orange accent #D9622B; warm temperature; alternating backgrounds of seamless beige gradient wall, light grey tile wall and warm wood countertop #B08050, with deep charcoal info screens as rhythm breaks; bright soft warm studio lighting with a front-left key, soft contact shadows and gentle raking side light for texture; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent thin-line terracotta icons with rounded rectangular info cards; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

Front-left soft warm key with gentle fill, soft contact shadow grounding the base, 4500K. provenance.notes: 11 片 800x1200 详情页切片提炼为 10 镜。分类纠正：源文件夹为「百货」，图中主体为厨房双层碗碟沥水收纳架，归 家居日用/厨房用品（未跟随源夹名，也与库内 家具家纺/收纳家具 的储物收纳柜区分定位）。已剥离：304 不锈钢等具体材质宣称与认证徽章文字（改为金属工艺微距与真实结构细节呈现）、PP 材质名、免打孔宣称、20 碗/14CM 等具体规格（改 {callout} 占位）、源店会员二维码与促销标签、装饰英文标语、产品黄绿配色（由 {product} 参考图带入）。痛点屏为对源第 3 屏「充分利用空间」文案主张的转化改写，源集无显式前后对比图。
